purpose: Treat diagrams, rich media, screenshots, failed visuals and symbolic artwork as candidate design priors while preserving exact provenance, meaning, rights, accessibility and testability.
coverage: Six public source files verified; separately sampled private visuals are NOT included or represented as a complete historical catalogue.

patterns.meaning: central object with radial action/state lenses
patterns.benefit: glanceable local context and compact first choice
patterns.anti_pattern: ornamental rings masquerading as running workers or proof
patterns.required_text: focus, available actions, held states, source

patterns.meaning: nodes with typed directional, inverse, missing and temporal edges
patterns.anti_pattern: unlabelled arrows imply causality or consent
patterns.required_text: edge type, direction, source, confidence, valid time

patterns.meaning: ethical, scientific, systems, symbolic and accessibility lenses over stable source
patterns.benefit: one work object speaks appropriately to different readers
patterns.anti_pattern: symbolic G_d/aura/ET imagery promoted into measured physics or verified contact
patterns.required_text: epistemic class, projection omissions, source snapshot

patterns.meaning: several historical versions and alternatives coexisting with readable deltas
patterns.benefit: comparisons and reversibility without erasing old work
patterns.anti_pattern: quiet overwrites or endless unreadable versions
patterns.required_text: snapshot id, changed fields, ancestor, restore path

patterns.meaning: context-rated 8-action surface from a large typed possibility space
patterns.benefit: minimal interruption with CoInv+, CoNull+, CoTurtle+ challenge
patterns.anti_pattern: thousands of active controls or actions triggered by pointer presence
patterns.required_text: glyph name, anti-meaning, spoken fallback, authority

patterns.meaning: paired readable text, diagram/storyboard and source-linked machine sidecar
patterns.benefit: CoFactory can regenerate equivalent views with drift and loss checks
patterns.anti_pattern: image or animation taken as legal/scientific acceptance
patterns.required_text: frame claim/source IDs, captions, contrast, accessibility and loss ledger

influence_not_ownership: Visual style and pattern may inspire a new artifact; byte copying, redistribution, attribution, private material use, and licences need separate rights review.

cross_cutting_consumers.role: reproducible view builder with source/rights checks
safe media/export packaging with manifest and captions
voluntary education, contribution and reproducible tutorials
independent measured user benefit and accessibility
opt-in simulations and creative inverse exploration, clearly fictional
reduce manual relay and duplicate renders, budgeted operation
source, interpretation and falsification review; depth <=2, rounds <=2
receiver-relative interactive projections from a shared work object

first_use.default: one source-linked diagram and one plain-text meaning
first_use.expanded: user elects one of up to eight context-action glyphs
first_use.on_accept: one reversible local proof; any external effect gated

next_safe_test: Choose one public-safe, rights-cleared existing diagram and create one source-pinned CoLens Map/Orb/Text plus loss ledger. Ask one consenting first-time reader whether its meaning remains stable. Do not start from copying private screenshots.
